scope.model: single central AC annual C-value comparison
scope.ideal_rh60_meaning: Saturation-only latent process; RH60 is an unmet evaluation target, not humidity control.
scope.standard_house_AC4: Separate API regression: sim検討2 / 隙間比較_003. Not these annual inputs.

changes.aoaf: Uniform-temperature NTU/contact-effectiveness heat and water transfer
changes.COP: Existing independent equipment model; no latent coil temperature argument. No acmodel source changes.

independent_water_check.allowance: Per step: rho * actual flow * Lv * (existing boundary tolerance + float32 humidity half-ULPs), plus exported flow, temperature and heat float32 quantization.
independent_water_check.initial_check: An initial fixed 0.03 W postprocessing limit rejected two solver-success cases. The check was corrected to use the existing 1e-7 kg/kg boundary tolerance in watts. Original records retained; solver, inputs and solver tolerances unchanged.

limitations: Single building/weather and temperature-priority annual comparison; not all buildings or controls.
BF and Ao/Af need calibration to actual equipment. Ao/Af low-velocity coefficient extension is an approximation.
Convergence does not mean all room temperature/RH targets are met.
Equipment-model COP differs from delivered heat/power effective COP during heating defrost; report displays both definitions.
